subject: Next steps: Security questionnaire kickoff (SIG) — Electra Health
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Ortega <jamie.ortega@electrahealth.com>, Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@electrahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & SIG kickoff items from today's call

Hi Jamie / Carlos —

Thanks again for a useful conversation today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) Scope: Electra Health is evaluating Redwood for inference on PHI-adjacent workloads (HIPAA-control scope + GDPR). You asked for a standard SIG (Consensus/CAIQ-style) and any SOC 2 evidence we can share.
2) Our ask: we'll prefill the SIG where we can to speed approvals, and then send back the spreadsheet for your review.
3) Timeline: target to return a prefilled SIG + supporting artifacts within 5 business days. If specific items need certified auditor evidence, flag those and we'll prioritize.

Clarifying questions for your team (helps us prefill accurately):
- Do you require Redwood to sign a BAA before we send BAA-related evidence?
- Is Electra expecting US-only data residency, or will EU residency be required for any environments?
- Any specific CAIQ sections you want us to prioritize (e.g., encryption key management, subprocessor disclosures, logging/retention)?
- Do you need SOC 2 Type II (latest report) or is a SOC 2 Type I / bridge letter sufficient for initial review?

Attachments: redwood_sig_prefill.xlsx (working prefill we plan to send).

I can route technical follow-ups to Rishi; Monica will help with procurement coordination.

Next step: Jamie — can you confirm (a) preferred file format (electra SIG XLSX works) and (b) if procurement needs a separate copy?

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Jamie Ortega <jamie.ortega@electrahealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@electrahealth.com>, procurement@electrahealth.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & SIG kickoff items from today's call

Thanks Tessa — great summary. A couple quick notes and I've attached our questionnaire template (Electra_SIG_v1.xlsx).

- Format: XLSX is perfect. Please return the prefilled workbook back to me and procurement@electrahealth.com.
- Evidence: We will need a SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) or an auditor bridge letter if the report is delayed. A SOC 2 summary PDF is ok initially for sizing.
- Residency: For this phase we require US-only processing. We may request EU residency later; we'll flag that in procurement if/when it happens.
- BAAs: Yes, we need Redwood to be willing to sign a BAA; procurement will start that conversation after we see the SIG answers.
- Timeline: 5 business days is reasonable. If you expect any sections to take longer, highlight them so procurement can accept a staggered delivery.

Specifics to clarify from our side (quick):
1) Are you able to provide customer-managed key support (KMS)?
2) Who are your primary subprocessors and do you have current attestations for them?

Attached: Electra_SIG_v1.xlsx (questionnaire).

—Jamie Ortega
Security & Procurement
Electra Health

On Mon, Oct 12, 2026 at 3:08 PM Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi Jamie / Carlos —
> 
> Thanks again for a useful conversation today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: ...
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Follow-up & SIG kickoff items from today's call (technical prefill notes)

Looping in my notes to help us prefill Electra's SIG. I will prepare the redwood_sig_prefill.xlsx with suggested answers and flag items that require engineering/legal review. High-level answers below (draft):

- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II control period ending Jan 31, 2026. We can provide the auditor report under NDA or a redacted SOC 2 summary PDF for initial review (attached SOC2_summary.pdf).
- HIPAA/GDPR: We support HIPAA-covered workloads under a BAA; we've implemented GDPR controls and have a DPA template.
- KMS/customer keys: We support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS / customer master keys for Dedicated/Private deployments; hosted customers may use our KMS by default.
- Data residency: Hosted by default in us-west-2; EU residency available for enterprise/private instances (requires contract flag). For Electra's current ask (US-only) we will confirm region placement.
- Subprocessors: primary subprocessors include AWS, Snowflake (optional for analytics), Sentry (error reporting), Datadog (metrics). We have current attestations for the primary cloud provider; we'll include a subprocessors list in the prefill.
- Logs & retention: Default operational logs retained 90 days; audit-level logs retained per contract up to 1 year or longer on request (enterprise add-on).

Attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf, redwood_sig_prefill.xlsx (draft).

I'll mark items that need legal signoff (BAA text, DPA clauses, proof of penetration test). Happy to discuss specifics with Jamie if they prefer a short technical call.

—Rishi
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Ortega <jamie.ortega@electrahealth.com>, Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@electrahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & SIG kickoff items from today's call

Hi Jamie —

Thanks for the confirmation. We've started on the prefill and attached a draft to our internal thread; we'll return the completed Electra_SIG_v1.xlsx to you and procurement@electrahealth.com by EOD next Wednesday (5 business days).

Two quick asks to make sure the prefill aligns with procurement expectations: 
1) Can you confirm whether Electra requires customer-managed KMS for the initial environment, or if 'ability to support CMK on request' is sufficient for the procurement review?
2) On SOC 2 evidence: do you need the full auditor report for the initial legal review or would a redacted report + auditor bridge letter suffice to progress the POC?

If easier, we can hop on a 20-minute call later this week to close these points.

Thanks and talk soon,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

notes: Thread contains prefill commitment and clarifying questions around BAA, KMS, SOC2 evidence and data residency. Internal technical input from Rishi included; procurement looped in.
